name: Farrowing
flow: tap a miscarriage / not in pig / removed row
Finish farrowing while an Edit draft waits
Save, or Back, when opened from Finish
Save, or Back, when opened from the locked record
Save, when opened from the blocked Finish
Back with the draft kept, when opened from the blocked Finish
Save, or Back, on a sow that died
End task early (sows still farrowing or unsaved)
tap the still-farrowing warning, then a sow
tap the will-be-removed warning, then a sow
tap an outcome, then a miscarriage sow
tap Sow deaths, then a sow

notes.purpose: The task's home: pick the next sow in one unit, see the unit's litter size and the whole task's progress, and jump by pen, ear tag or search.
states: Default: lens All, no filter, every sow of Unit 7 grouped by pen (sample: B1 1 sow, B2 1, B3 2, B4 3 = 7 sows)
Lens Awaiting / Active / Done: only rows in that state are listed; the other pens' sows stay in the pen header count
Filter applied: funnel shows a count badge, a summary line "Due: … · Parity …" with a Clear action appears under the tabs, tab counts shrink to the filtered set
Pen partly filtered: pen header shows "N shown" beside its sow count
Empty list: "No awaiting sows" / "No matching sows" with a hint ("Adjust the filters…" or "Choose another status…")
Scrolled: the tab bar and filter line stay stuck at the top; the dock pen code follows the pen under the sticky bar
Unit switched (from the Task overview): list, scroll and current pen are kept per unit and reset when the filter or lens changed
Task already ended: the room is replaced by the prototype's Today card "Task ended · N finished / View receipt"
Launched from Home's whole-farm card: the prototype opens the Task overview sheet over the room first (see issues)

elements.name: App bar
elements.logic: Chevron labelled "Back to Today": leaves the task. When launched from Home it returns to Home (same section, same unit scope); stand-alone it shows the prototype's own Today card.

elements.name: Phone status bar
elements.logic: Prototype phone chrome, not product UI.

elements.name: Last record line
elements.logic: Time and hand of the newest record in the unit. In the prototype it is fixed text: 08:41, or 09:41 once any sow in the unit carries the 09:41 stamp a live tap writes; the hand is always "G. Hansen".
elements.source: prototype farrowing-astra-concept.js room() "latest"; not computed from events (unclear: should be the newest event time and hand)

elements.name: Unit card · name
elements.logic: The unit whose sows are listed below. Changes only through the unit list on the Task overview sheet or the Home Choose unit door.

elements.name: Unit card · value
elements.logic: The unit's average live piglets per litter, one KPI for the unit. In the prototype it is a fixed sample (unit.livePerLitter = 10); not derived from the litters shown. Period and cohort of the average are not stated.
elements.source: prototype farrowing-astra-concept.js sampleUnit()/roomContext() livePerLitter; ux/research/farrowing/ASTRA-ROOM-PAGE-AUDIT.md says "illustrative 10 / target 12"

elements.name: Unit card · Target 12
elements.logic: The unit's per-litter target. The text is hard-coded and always amber because belowTarget is hard-coded true; it is not compared with the 10. The context also holds bornAliveTarget = 12, which only the End task performance metrics read. Target is not editable here.
elements.source: prototype farrowing-astra-concept.js room() AstraTaskOverview.render unit.target, belowTarget; console config not designed (unclear: where the target is configured)

elements.name: Task overview card · heading
elements.logic: The right half of the context strip is one button; whole card (heading, number, bar, support line) opens the Task overview sheet. The chevron marks it as the only interactive half.

elements.name: Task overview card · value
elements.logic: Numerator = Farrowed: sows in ALL units whose litter is finished (locked), excluding miscarriage / not-in-pig / removed outcomes and excluding sows that died before or during farrowing (a sow that died after finishing stays counted). Denominator = Farrowed + Active + Awaiting, so other outcomes leave both the number and the bar. Never changes with the room's lens or filter.

elements.name: Task overview card · label
elements.logic: "Farrowed" is the counted thing; "· all units" states the scope (unlike the unit card and the tab counts, which are Unit 7 only).

elements.name: Task overview card · progress bar
elements.logic: Segments Farrowed / Active / Awaiting with widths proportional to their counts (sample 7 : 2 : 9 of 18); zero segments are omitted. aria-valuenow = Farrowed. Not tappable on its own.

elements.name: Task overview card · support line
elements.logic: Active and Awaiting counts across all units: the same two numbers the bar segments show, as text.

elements.name: State tabs
elements.logic: One tab strip. Counts are for the CURRENT unit only and respect the active filter (so they shrink when a filter is applied). Awaiting = no live total yet; Active = live total above zero and not finished; Done = finished litters, sows that died (they stay as a Done-register row) and sows with a recorded outcome. Default tab is All. Each tab has a spoken label "Awaiting, 4 sows".

elements.name: Filter button
elements.shows: Funnel icon, count badge when filtering
elements.logic: Opens the Filter sows sheet. Badge = number of active filters (due range, parity: 0-2). Below the tabs a line "Due: Today – In 2 days · Parity 2–5" with Clear shows while any filter is active.

elements.name: Pen card · header
elements.logic: Pen code, number of task sows in that pen (always the full count, ignoring lens and filter), chevron. Tapping the header opens that pen's detail sheet. "N shown" appears only when the lens or filter hides some of the pen's sows. Pens are ordered alphanumerically; pens with no visible sow are not listed.

elements.name: Row · ear tag
elements.logic: The sow's id, mono 13px. Identifies the row; no strike-through or special style has meaning. Sits above the state chip.

elements.name: Row · Active chip
elements.logic: Shown when the live total (alive + dead) is above zero and the litter is not finished. Disappears when she is recounted back to zero (she reads Awaiting again).

elements.name: Row · Done chip
elements.logic: Shown when the litter is finished (locked). Done rows end with a pencil icon instead of a chevron.

elements.name: Row · Sow died chip
elements.logic: Shown instead of Done when farrowing ended through the sow's death. She stays in the room as a Done-register row.

elements.name: Row · Awaiting line 1
elements.shows: Due today / Due tomorrow / Due in 2 days / Due yesterday / Overdue · 3 days
elements.logic: Days from due (expected date = service + 114 days; the gestation day is never printed on rows). "Overdue" from day 116; only the number "3 days" is red, the word stays ink. Tomorrow and later ("forecast") are drawn lighter/muted. Awaiting rows carry no chip.
elements.source: prototype farrowing-astra-concept.js roomRow(); sow.due text (sample); RULINGS "Model"

elements.name: Row · Awaiting line 2
elements.logic: Her parity and the number born in her last litter (default 12 when unknown).

elements.name: Row · Active/Done/Died line 1
elements.logic: Alive = the live Alive count (Active: posted + this visit; Done: alive now, falls when later deaths are recorded). Dead = sum of all dead types recorded. Same format on Active, Done and Sow died rows.

elements.name: Row · Active/Done/Died line 2
elements.logic: born N = alive + dead (derived, frozen at finish). Then recency in words: Active "1h ago" (prototype fixed text; "just now" after a tap in this session), Done "final 05:58" (the time she was finished), Sow died "yesterday". Then the hand's initials of the newest record: the prototype always prints G.H (L.M for the died sow). Never coloured by age.
elements.source: prototype farrowing-astra-concept.js roomRow(); ux/research/farrowing/RULINGS.md "Model" (interval chip retired)

elements.name: Row · rail icon
elements.logic: Chevron = opens the live record. Pencil = a finished (locked) record that can still be edited.

elements.name: Row · outcome sow
elements.shows: Miscarriage / Not in pig / Removed from batch
elements.logic: A sow with a recorded production outcome shows the outcome as line 1 and "Recorded · hh:mm · G.H" as line 2, counts as Done, and opens the Production log instead of a sheet.

elements.name: Dock · Go to pen
elements.logic: Left dock button. The pen code is the pen currently at the top of the list under the sticky bar (updates while scrolling, after a jump and after opening a sow). Opens the pen map.
elements.source: prototype farrowing-astra-concept.js room() dock-pen; scroll handler

elements.name: Dock · Scan ear tag
elements.shows: Scan ear tag (scan icon, dark primary button)
elements.logic: The one icon-with-label pairing the rulings sanction. Opens the scan sheet.

elements.name: Dock · Search
elements.logic: Icon-only button labelled "Search ear tag". Opens the Find a sow sheet.

controls.control: Back chevron in the app bar
controls.does: leaves the task (Home when launched from Home)

controls.control: Task overview card (right half of the strip)

controls.does: switch the lens in place; scroll resets to the top of the list

opens the Filter sows sheet (not a separate screen): expected-farrowing range slider (7+ days ago … in 7+ days), Parity chips (Any, 0, 1, 2–5, 6+), Reset, "Show N sows"; Apply keeps the filter until Clear
opens a Pen sheet (not a separate screen): notices, Feed guidance, Report equipment fault, Add/Edit pen note, Pen log, each with its own sub-page
opens her sheet with nothing recorded yet

controls.control: Outcome row (miscarriage, not in pig, removed)

controls.does: opens the pen map sheet: A–D columns by rows 1–6, each tile with a one-word fact (Active, 2 active, Overdue, N born with a tick, Due today, Not in task, No matches); tap jumps to the pen and highlights it for 0.9 s; long-press 0.35 s peeks at its sows; tiles with no visible sow are disabled
opens the scan sheet: camera is not connected in the prototype; "Try sample tag 000418" opens that sow; also holds the ear-tag text search
opens "Find a sow": text field (ear tag or pen) with live results "N sows found"; a result opens like a row

copy: (raw) Task overview · 7 / 18 · Farrowed · all units · 2 active · 9 awaiting
(raw) Due today · Due tomorrow · Due in N days · Due yesterday · Overdue · N days
(raw) Go to pen · Scan ear tag · Search ear tag
(raw) No awaiting sows · No matching sows
edge: A sow whose live total returns to zero (undo, Edit) moves back from Active to Awaiting and gets her Due line again
A sow farrowing early or late is never red once she has a record: the overdue number only shows on Awaiting rows
Pen with sows of mixed status: the header count is the pen's total, rows follow the lens
Filter that hides every sow: empty state with the filter hint; Clear / Reset recovers
Unit switch keeps each unit's own scroll position and current pen when lens and filter are unchanged
Returning from a sow restores the scroll and the pen he left from
Sow with a draft (unsaved Edit) is blocked from task end (see End task), but the row shows nothing about the draft
Done lens includes sow-died and outcome rows, so Done (8 across units) can exceed "Farrowed" (7)
rules: "Rows speak in days from due, never gestation day" (Model)
"Every litter row carries its three numbers … alive · dead on line 1, born on line 2" (Model)
"No staleness tracking on Active sows" / interval chip retired (Model)
"The overdue signal ends at the first record" (Model)
"She stays in the room" with a red sow-died chip (Starting and ending a session)
"Identity is sheet-first … the room row offers no sow-page target" (Surfaces & entrances)
"Color lives on the value, the word stays ink" (Model)
"Dates speak relative within the week" (Names and glyphs; copy pass)
"words carry actions, icons carry objects" — the dock's Scan ear tag is the one sanctioned icon + text pairing (Names and glyphs)
issues: Same facts at two scopes on one screen: the unit card and the state tabs are Unit 7 only (and the tabs follow the filter); the Task overview card is all units and ignores the filter. Only the card says its scope ("all units"); the tabs do not say "Unit 7".
Active and Awaiting are stated three times at two scopes: the card's bar segments, its text "2 active · 9 awaiting", and the tabs "Active 1 · Awaiting 4".

"Done 2" (tabs) and "Farrowed 7" (card) look like the same measure but count differently (Done includes sows that died and outcome rows; Farrowed excludes sows that died before/during farrowing and all outcomes). Neither label explains the difference.

"Live / litter 10" and "Target 12" are fixed sample text; the 10 is not computed from litters and contradicts the End task performance metric (Born alive / litter 12.0 against the same target 12 in the sample). The label does not say over which period or which litters. unclear: source, period and who sets the target.
"Target 12" is always amber because belowTarget is hard-coded; it would read as a warning even when the unit meets the target.

"Last record 08:41 · G. Hansen" is fixed text and repeats what each Active row's "1h ago · G.H" already says; the one-sentence task copy the contract requires under it ("Count as she farrows. Every tap saves, come back anytime. Finish when she's done.") is missing.
Row recency ("1h ago") and hand ("G.H") are hard-coded, not derived from record stamps; the Active text does not tick (contract: minutes under 1 h, hours under 24 h, yesterday).
Overdue sows: the ruled second line "induced yesterday · L.M" (latest disposition from the sow page) is not implemented; an overdue row only shows the parity line.

Pen headers are tappable (chevron, pen sheet with feed guidance, equipment fault, pen note, pen log). The rulings call pen headers census-only dead zones and name no pen tools; unclear whose feature these belong to and whether they should live in a farrowing task.
Two search doors: the magnifier opens Find a sow and the Scan ear tag sheet also contains the same text search.
The due-range filter matches the sow's stored due text, so it also hides or shows Active and Done sows by a due date that no longer matters to them.

Entry mismatch: the owner confirmed Home's Farrowing card lands on this room list, but the code opens the Task overview sheet over it for the whole-farm entry (entry=overview) and its Back returns to Home; only a unit entry (Choose unit) lands here.
Header icon-only X on sheets plus Back plus grab handle plus backdrop are four exits for one sheet (see Counting).

notes.purpose: Keep the live count while she farrows: one big Alive number whose + and - save at once, the litter so far, and the doors to deaths, corrections, the log and Finish.
states: Default (sample 000418): Alive 9, Dead 5, Born 14, receipt "Saved · +4 this visit"
Visit with nothing changed: receipt reads "Saved"
After - taps: pending falls; if it goes below zero the receipt reads "Saved · N died this visit"
At the Born floor (Alive cannot go down): - is greyed (aria-disabled); tapping it shows "Use Record dead for deaths. Use Edit for corrections." for 4 s in place of the receipt
Edit draft waiting (changes saved nowhere): Finish farrowing stays enabled here but the Finish sheet will be blocked
No events and Alive 0: this is the Before first count screen

elements.name: Header · sow id
elements.logic: The sow's ear-tag id followed by a chevron; the whole title is a button (44px hit area) and is the one door to her sow page. Id is plain text in the mono face, no strike-through or other styling carries meaning.
elements.source: prototype farrowing-astra-concept.js identity(); tag from the sow record

elements.name: Header · pen / parity
elements.logic: Pen code, then "Parity n" (her current parity from the sow record).

elements.name: Header · state line
elements.logic: Status word for the sow: "Farrowing" once her live total is above zero; "Due today" (the room's Due line without the day number) while nothing is recorded; "Finished …" / "Died …" for locked records. The gestation day and the started / saved stamp the rulings put in this header are not shown.

elements.name: Header · close (X)
elements.shows: X icon button, label "Close sow drawer"
elements.logic: Same exit as Back: leaves the sheet and returns to the room list (also folds the open visit when on Counting). The grab handle and the backdrop are a third and fourth way out.

elements.name: Alive label
elements.logic: Names the hero number.

elements.name: Hero stepper · -
elements.logic: Takes one off Alive and off the open visit. Floor: Alive cannot go below B* minus the dead recorded (min alive = anchor - total dead; in the sample 10 - 5 = 5). At the floor the key is greyed, nothing is written and the pointer text appears. aria-disabled only.

elements.name: Hero value
elements.logic: Alive now = posted + this visit. Plain numeral in the mono face, no box, grey when 0. Not typeable (type-to-set is retired).

elements.name: Hero stepper · +
elements.logic: Adds one; always allowed. The first + on an Awaiting sow makes her Active.

elements.name: Receipt
elements.logic: Live status under the number. "+4" = piglets added this visit (pending); down form "Saved · 2 died this visit". The visit folds into one log line when the sheet is left.

elements.name: Pointer text
elements.shows: Use Record dead for deaths. Use Edit for corrections.
elements.logic: Replaces the receipt for 4 s after tapping a greyed minus.

elements.name: Litter summary heading
elements.logic: Section title with a link to the Farrowing log; disabled when no event and no pending count exist.

elements.name: Litter summary · Born
elements.logic: Born = Alive + all dead (derived, never typed). While counting it moves with both numbers.

elements.name: Litter summary · Dead
elements.logic: Sum of the six dead types recorded.

elements.name: Litter summary · causes line
elements.logic: One chip per type with a non-zero count; hidden when Dead is 0.

elements.name: Action row · Edit
elements.logic: Opens Edit record; disabled when nothing has been recorded.

elements.name: Action row · Record death
elements.shows: Record death (alert icon), small "Unsaved" under it when a death draft exists
elements.logic: Opens the death drawer. A pending draft would be flagged "Unsaved" (cannot currently survive leaving the drawer, see issues).

elements.name: Action row · More actions
elements.logic: Opens the sow page with its Actions sheet open (farrowing actions listed there).

elements.name: Bar · Back
elements.logic: Folds the open visit (one "+N alive" log line, anchor = Born) and returns to the room list.

elements.name: Bar · Finish farrowing
elements.logic: Opens the Finish sheet. Disabled until Born is above zero.

controls.does: change Alive; each tap is saved at once
opens the sow page (Pig profile) with the Actions sheet / the profile
opens the Finish sheet (Lock blocked version if an Edit draft waits)
leave to the room list (visit folds)

copy: (raw) Use Record dead for deaths. Use Edit for corrections.
edge: Counting - to zero un-crosses her: she reads Awaiting again (Before first count)
Leaving by any exit folds the visit; reopening shows the folded total
Floor depends on posted dead: recording a death lowers the floor so - becomes possible
An Edit draft kept with Back is not lost; Finish then opens blocked
rules: "Born = Alive + Σ Dead … Derived, never entered" (Model)
"The Born floor … + is free; − drains pending and clamps at the floor" (Model)
"The hero numeral is plain … the keys own the input" (Model)
"Type-to-set is retired on count figures" (Surfaces & entrances)

"The exit word is always Back" (Piglet processing, Round 5)
issues: Four exits for one sheet: the X in the header, the Back button, the grab handle and the backdrop; the rulings keep the handle/backdrop and a bar exit but no close button.
Born and Dead are shown here and again on Finish, the locked record and the log; the summary card duplicates the Edit, log and Finish doors' own context.
Sheet header lacks the ruled recency stamp (saved hh:mm · who, started hh:mm) and the day count; the status word "Farrowing" repeats what the room chip says.
The pointer text differs from the ruled two-pointer copy ("Found dead? Record dead" · "Wrong count? Edit") and replaces the receipt instead of using the reserved line under it, so the layout moves.
Button reads "Record death"; the rulings and contract name it "Record dead".
Minus at the floor is only aria-disabled; whether it looks disabled depends on CSS (grey, not dimmed per the ruling's scoped exception).

notes.purpose: The same counting sheet for a sow with nothing recorded yet: Alive 0, with Record death live (a stillborn can be the first record) and Edit / Finish unavailable.
states: Default (sample 000455, B4): Alive 0, no events
Overdue sow: state line reads "Overdue · 3 days"
After the first + (or first death) she becomes Farrowing on the same sheet; the room row crosses to Active when she is left
Counted back to zero later: reads this state again, but View log and Edit remain available if events exist

elements.name: Header · sow id
elements.logic: The sow's ear-tag id followed by a chevron; the whole title is a button (44px hit area) and is the one door to her sow page. Id is plain text in the mono face, no strike-through or other styling carries meaning.

elements.name: Header · pen / parity
elements.logic: Pen code, then "Parity n" (her current parity from the sow record).

elements.name: Header · state line

elements.name: Header · close (X)
elements.shows: X icon button, label "Close sow drawer"
elements.logic: Same exit as Back: leaves the sheet and returns to the room list (also folds the open visit when on Counting). The grab handle and the backdrop are a third and fourth way out.

elements.name: Hero value
elements.logic: Zero state of the Alive number; - is greyed (nothing to undo), + is live.

elements.name: Receipt

elements.name: Litter summary

elements.name: Action row

notes.purpose: The one dead drawer: tally piglets that were born dead or died by type, or record the sow's own death. Opened during farrowing in this preview; the same drawer also opens from Before first count, Finish, the locked record and the ended record.
states: Piglets mode, nothing drafted: header "Dead 5", rows at rest, Save disabled, Clear disabled
Piglets mode with a draft (preset: one Crushed drafted): header "Dead 6" with "Born dead or died · 1 unsaved" in green, Crushed row shows 3 in green with its - enabled, Save enabled
The sow mode: radio list of causes, red warning band, Save is hold-to-commit
The sow mode with a piglet draft or an Edit draft: warning "Save or clear the pending piglet deaths / correction before ending" with a Review button, Save disabled
After finish (opened from the locked record): + is capped so the drafted deaths cannot exceed Alive now; saving lowers Alive now
Ended sow: only the Piglets segment is offered
Photo dialog over the drawer (tap a thumbnail): Back, Delete

elements.name: Title row
elements.logic: Total of the dead already saved (5 in the sample) plus the draft.

elements.name: Subtitle
elements.logic: The green "N unsaved" is the draft count; it disappears when the draft is empty.

elements.name: Clear
elements.logic: Discards the draft (and, in sow mode, the chosen cause and note); disabled when nothing is drafted.

elements.name: Segment
elements.logic: Two-way control; hidden down to Piglets only once the sow has died.

elements.name: Type rows
elements.shows: Stillborn · Mummified · Crushed · Scours · Starve-out · Other, each - n +
elements.logic: Value = saved total + this draft; draft value green. - only undoes the draft (disabled at 0 draft). + has no limit before finish; after finish it stops when the draft reaches Alive now. Other is a plain row.

elements.name: Photos field
elements.logic: Camera button is disabled until a death is drafted (or a sow cause is chosen). Each tap opens the file/camera input; thumbnails open the photo dialog. Photos ride the save.

elements.name: Sow mode · causes
elements.logic: Single choice; choosing Other adds an optional "Details · optional" line.

elements.name: Sow mode · warning band
elements.shows: Saving ends farrowing · 7 alive stay under piglet care
elements.logic: Always shown in sow mode; the number is the current Alive. When a piglet or Edit draft exists, a "Review piglet deaths" / "Review correction" button and the sentence "Save or clear the pending … before ending." are added.

elements.name: Bar · Back
elements.logic: In this prototype Back discards the draft (and any sow cause) before returning to the sheet it was opened from.

elements.name: Bar · Save
elements.shows: Save (piglets) / Save with caption HOLD TO SAVE (the sow)
elements.logic: Piglets: adds the draft to the dead types, writes one log line "+3 crushed · +1 other" and returns. The sow: 0.85 s hold; ends farrowing, freezes Born, writes "Sow died · cause"; disabled without a cause or with any draft/correction waiting.

Header "Dead 6" and the subtitle "1 unsaved" and the green Crushed 3 all say the same draft three times.

Button and title copy "Record death" / "Dead" mix with the ruled "Record dead".
